HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HISTORY AND CITIZENSHIP
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about French Revolutions is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat French Revolutions as rumours only.
   B. Say French Revolutions never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing French Revolutions.
   D. Explain French Revolutions with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. Which statement about Political developments in independent Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Political developments in independent Africa never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Political developments in independent Africa as rumours only.
   C. Explain Political developments in independent Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Political developments in independent Africa.

3. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)

   B. Kisumu
   C. Nakuru
   D. Mombasa

   D. Explain Internal conflicts in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Avoiding all community work
   B. Littering in markets
   C. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   D. Destroying road signs

7. Which statement about National Security is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat National Security as rumours only.
   B. Say National Security never happens in Kenya.

   C. Treat Civilisations in South and Central Africa as rumours only.
   D. Say Civilisations in South and Central Africa never happens in Kenya.

9. Which statement about Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship.
   C. Treat Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship as rumours only.
   D. Explain Critical issues in Kenyan History and Citizenship with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Hide all money underground
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Avoid saving forever

11. Which statement about Kenyans Response to Colonialism is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Kenyans Response to Colonialism never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Kenyans Response to Colonialism.
   C. Explain Kenyans Response to Colonialism with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Kenyans Response to Colonialism as rumours only.

12. Which statement about Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya as rumours only.
   C. Explain Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Public Resources under the Constitution of Kenya.

13. Which statement about Colonial Administration in Africa is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Colonial Administration in Africa with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Colonial Administration in Africa.
   C. Say Colonial Administration in Africa never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Colonial Administration in Africa as rumours only.

14. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Explain symbols used on a map
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Name the president

15. Which statement about Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century.
   B. Say Organisation of Kenyan Communities since 19th century never happens in Kenya.

16. Which statement about Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya.
   C. Explain Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Structure and functions of the county government of Kenya never happens in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
17. In three clear sentences, explain French Revolutions and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Aligned and Non-Aligned Movements from 1970 to 2020 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
